summary: The new half-disc Morrey results are genuinely new and reuse the reflection, local-Wkp and uniqueness APIs, but the shifted-half-disc Wkp bound duplicates the existing centred theorem in parallel, and the new proof rebuilds existing ReImTopology lemmas by hand.
